title: particle rain
description: Colored particles drift down like rain. Tap anywhere to create a circular repulsion field that pushes them away. Score increases while no particles touch the bottom edge.

title: color flood
description: A grid of 8x8 squares slowly fills with color spreading from the center. Click any square to reset it to black. Try to keep more than half the grid dark.

title: orbit trails
description: Two dots orbit a center point leaving fading color trails. Tap to reverse one orbit's direction. Purely aesthetic, no score. The interference patterns are the point.

title: springy snake
description: A chain of 20 connected circles follows your mouse or finger with springy physics. The tail whips around with momentum. Passive toy.

title: bubble math
description: Bubbles with numbers 1-9 rise slowly from the bottom. Click two bubbles whose numbers sum to 10 to pop them. Bubbles that escape the top cost a life. Three lives.

title: growing tree
description: A generative tree grows upward from the bottom center. New branches split every 2 seconds. Click a branch to prune it. The final shape is sculpted by your cuts.

title: gravity wells
description: White dots float in zero-g. Click to place a gravity well that attracts nearby dots. Dots that collide merge and grow. Place up to 5 wells.

title: wave machine
description: A horizontal line of dots connected by springs. Drag any dot up or down to create a wave that propagates. Multiple waves interfere with each other. Passive physics toy.

title: light chaser
description: A small bright dot teleports to a random position every 2 seconds. Tap it before it moves to score. It gets faster. Miss 3 times and it's over.

title: cellular automaton
description: A grid runs a Game of Life variant. Tap cells to toggle them alive or dead. The simulation runs continuously. Patterns that persist score points over time.
